description: This file contains implementation of a custom stream filter class and an abstract base class for stream filtering tests in an Orleans-based testing environment. It defines filtering logic based on string criteria, manages test setup and execution, and references external testing and Orleans stream infrastructure.

classes.name: CustomStreamFilter
classes.description: Implements IStreamFilter interface, providing custom logic to determine if items should be delivered to subscribers based on filter data. Uses dependency-injected logger for diagnostics.

classes.name: StreamFilteringTestsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for stream filtering tests, providing common setup, utilities, and test case methods for verifying filtering behavior in Orleans stream tests.

methods.name: ShouldDeliver
methods.description: Determines whether a specific item should be delivered based on the filter data string.

methods.name: ShouldDeliverImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation of filtering logic based on filterData values such as 'throw', 'even', 'only3', 'only7'.

methods.name: IgnoreBadFilter
methods.description: Test method that verifies the behavior when the filter throws an exception upon receiving a 'throw' filterData.

methods.name: OnlyEvenItems
methods.description: Test method that verifies only even numbers are delivered when 'even' filterData is used.

methods.name: MultipleSubscriptionsDifferentFilterData
methods.description: Test method that verifies multiple subscriptions with different filter data are handled correctly, and only the expected filtered items are received.

methods.name: EnsureStreamFilterIsRegistered
methods.description: Utility method ensuring the CustomStreamFilter is properly registered before running tests.
